extraction: Agent Eval Harness (ashishlandiwal): Evaluation & observability for LLM agents - layer that decides if agent is safe to ship. Traced RAG customer-support agent, eval suite, LLM-as-judge calibration (Cohen's kappa), drift monitoring, CI regression gate that fails build when quality drops. Runs offline. agent_eval.py, eval_dataset.jsonl, eval_thresholds.json, human_labels.jsonl, knowledge_base.jsonl. Most demos prove 'I can build it' - this proves 'I can tell when it's broken and stop it from shipping'. Production instinct frontier labs screen for.
